units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:4:2">Y. Peah VIII, 20ᵈ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="B01342"><he>בְּרָתָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="R00814"><he>צְרָרַיָּא</he></cite>, <he>צְרָרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:4:4">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>משדי עלוי צ׳</he> threw pebbles at it (the moon).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:28">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כד מבחרא בצ׳</he> (not <he>מתברא בצדדיא</he>) when she picks the pebbles out (of the wheat).
